title: Document
description: OpenDoc Reader document IR, schema version 1. Every engine produces this model and every exporter reads it. JSON keys are camelCase. All coordinates are pixels of the rendered page image (`Page.sourceImage`), origin at the top left, as [x1, y1, x2, y2]. All file paths are absolute paths in the native format of the host OS. The Python reference implementation is engine/src/opendoc_engine/ir.py; docs/protocol.md explains where IR files live and which RPC methods write them.

schemaVersion.description: IR schema version. A reader rejects any other value.

pages.description: Converted pages in page order. A finished document holds one entry per source page.

Source.title: Source
Source.description: The file the document was read from.

path.description: Absolute path of the original file.

pageCount.description: Number of pages in the source file (frames, for a multi-page TIFF).

EngineInfo.title: EngineInfo
EngineInfo.description: Which engine and model produced the content. Text taken from a PDF text layer uses id `pdf-text` and model `text-layer`.

id.description: Engine id, as listed by engine.capabilities.

model.description: Manifest model id, or `none` for engines that use no model.

Page.title: Page
Page.description: One converted page. `blocks` are stored in reading order, and for multi-column pages that order is the only column information kept. A table never continues onto the next page in v1; a table split by a page break is two tables.

index.description: 0-based page index within the source file.

width.description: Width in pixels of the page image.

height.description: Height in pixels of the page image.

sourceImage.description: Absolute path of the rendered and preprocessed page image (PNG, 200 DPI for PDFs). All bounding boxes refer to this image.

blocks.description: Blocks in reading order. `order` of each block equals its array index. Block ids are unique within a document.

BBox.title: BBox
BBox.description: [x1, y1, x2, y2] in page pixels.

Block.title: Block
Block.description: A layout element on a page. Which optional fields are set depends on `type`: headings use `level` and `text`; paragraphs, captions, headers, footers, footnotes, page numbers and `other` use `text`; lists use `items`; tables use `table`; formulas use `latex` (and `number` when the page prints an equation number); figures use `figure` once the crop is written. `text` is inline Markdown (emphasis, links, inline math as $...$).

id.description: Unique within the document. Engines use `p{pageIndex}-b{order}`; blocks inside table cells append `-r{row}c{col}`.

order.description: Reading-order index within the page, contiguous from 0. Blocks inside a table cell number from 0 within the cell.

lines.description: Optional line-level boxes and text for text blocks. Not used by the Word and Markdown exporters; kept for the searchable PDF export planned for v0.2. Engines that cannot produce line boxes omit the field.

items.description: List entries, with nesting. List blocks only.

latex.description: Formula source without math delimiters. Formula blocks only.

number.description: The equation number printed next to a formula, as printed, for example "(1)". Formula blocks only.

crop.description: Absolute path of the PNG cropped from the page image.

for.description: Id of the figure or table block this caption describes.

cells.description: One entry per anchored cell. A cell covered by another cell's span has no entry.

header.description: Present and true for header cells.

blocks.description: Cell content, usually one paragraph. Cell blocks are never tables: nested tables are not supported in v1.
